402. Swimming Pool Water Levels

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Kumar , motivated by seeing the olympics , decides to take up swimming and builds N swimming pools . Each swimming pool has no water initially . Kumar hires a contractor who agreed to fill the swimming pools in a bizarre way. He will use a helicopter which can dispense water which will fill all swimming pools numbered j ( x<=j<=y) between x and y with some quantity Q. However kumar suspects that the contractor is trying to fool him. So he occasionally checks the total water level in swimming pools numbered k ( L<=k<=R) for some L and R. Help Kumar perform the above operations
input_spec:
First line contains a single integer N - the number of swimming pools Kumar has bought
The second line contains E - the no of events that can occur
Next E lines can be either of the following:
1 x y Q : The helicopter fills all pools j ( x<=j<=y) with Q quantity of water
2 L R : Kumar wants to know the total level of water in pools with number k (L<=k<=R)
output_spec: For each event where kumar wants to know the maximum level of water print a single line on each integer
